layout.arrangement: White slide with a thin red rectangular frame around the whole content area. Title 'Revision' in bold red at the top-left, just inside the frame; a yellow circular badge containing the slide number '5' at the top-right, overlapping the frame corner. Below the title, three full-width stacked content panels (each a bordered rectangle spanning roughly 8%-88% of the slide width): panel 1 (cream fill, blue border) with the chain-rule content, panel 2 (cream fill, blue border) with the weighted-sum/derivative content, panel 3 (light-green fill, green border) with the multi-variable chain-rule content. A black horizontal strip (video-player overlay) runs along the very bottom edge of the image.

layout.hierarchy: The red bold title 'Revision' is the strongest element at the top-left, followed by the yellow '5' badge which is the only filled shape. The three stacked bordered panels dominate the slide body; within them the eye is drawn to the red 'Conclusion:' label and the red/green/blue colour-coded derivative fractions, with the blue 'One Term ONLY' call-out as a secondary emphasis on the right of panel 2. The green panel 3 is visually separated from the two cream panels by its distinct fill and border colour.

visual_elements.description: Panel 1: rectangle with pale cream fill (#FFFDE7) and thin blue (#3333CC) border, containing two lines of chain-rule text and the 'Chain Rule' label.

Panel 2: rectangle with pale cream fill (#FFFDE7) and thin blue (#3333CC) border, containing the weighted-sum equation, three partial-derivative equations, the 'Conclusion:' line and the 'One Term ONLY' annotation.
Panel 3: rectangle with light green fill (#E8F5E9) and thin green (#339933) border, containing the three-input chain-rule derivation with bracketed terms and a summation from i=1 to 3.
Yellow filled circle with thin dark-red/dark outline containing the black numeral '5' (slide number badge).
Thin red rectangular outline framing the entire slide content area.
Solid black horizontal bar at the very bottom of the image (video player overlay / letterbox), spanning most of the width.

imagery: Yellow circular slide-number badge with the numeral '5' at the top-right (simple flat graphic, no photo).
No photographs, illustrations or pictograms; the slide is entirely typographic/mathematical with coloured bordered panels.
typography_notes: Title 'Revision' is a bold sans-serif (Arial-like) in red, noticeably larger and heavier than the body. All body text is a serif face (Times New Roman-like). Mathematical variables and equations are set in italic serif; prose clauses ('if ... is changed', 'will be changed accordingly', 'then') are upright serif. Colour coding is consistent: numerators ∂c and ∂b in red, denominators ∂a and ∂w in green, ∂a/∂b-type numerators in blue, implication arrows '⇒' in red. 'Chain Rule' is bold italic black; 'Conclusion:' is bold italic red; 'One Term ONLY' is blue italic with 'ONLY' bold; 'and' is bold black; the bracketed '[ through a₁,a₂,a₃ ]' is blue. Summation signs are large display-style glyphs with the upper limit (n or 3) above and lower limit (i=1) below. The 'W' in 'b=f(W)' appears bold and underlined. No bullet glyphs are used; content is arranged as free-standing lines inside bordered panels.
animation_state: No mid-build state is visible; all three panels, the title and the slide-number badge are fully rendered with every line of text present.
recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide size to 16:9 (approx 900 x 506 px reference) with a plain white background (#FFFFFF).
2. Draw a thin red (#CC0000) rectangle outline, unfilled, with a ~1 pt line, spanning roughly x 6%-94% and y 8%-95% of the slide.
3. Add the title text box at the top-left (x ~8%, y ~11%): 'Revision', Arial Bold, ~20 pt, colour #CC0000.
4. Add an oval at the top-right (centre approx x 91%, y 13%, diameter approx 4% of width) filled #FFFF66 with a thin dark-red outline, and type the numeral '5' centred inside it in black, ~14 pt.
5. Draw panel 1: rectangle at x 7.5%-88%, y 14%-32%, fill #FFFDE7, outline #3333CC ~1 pt, no shadow.
6. In panel 1, line 1 (Times New Roman, ~16 pt): 'b=f(a)    c=f(b)    ⇒    c=f(a)    if a is changed , c will be changed accordingly' — set 'b=f(a)', 'c=f(b)', 'c=f(a)' in black italic; the '⇒' in red; the 'a' and the 'c' inside the prose clause in bold red italic; the remaining prose in black upright.
7. In panel 1, line 2: the equation '∂c/∂a = ∂c/∂b * ∂b/∂a' built from stacked fractions (numerator over denominator with a fraction bar): first fraction ∂c (red) over ∂a (green), second ∂c (red) over ∂b (green), third ∂b (blue) over ∂a (green), joined by black '=' and '*'. To the right of it add the label 'Chain Rule' in bold italic black, ~14 pt.
8. Draw panel 2: rectangle at x 7.5%-88%, y 33%-64%, fill #FFFDE7, outline #3333CC ~1 pt.
9. Panel 2 line 1: 'b=f(W) = w₁a₁+w₂a₂+w₃a₃+.....+wₙaₙ = Σ_{i=1}^{n} wᵢaᵢ' in black italic serif (~16 pt), with 'W' bold/underlined, and a large display summation sign with 'n' above and 'i=1' below.
10. Panel 2 line 2: three spaced equations '∂b/∂w₁ = a₁', '∂b/∂w₂ = a₂', '∂b/∂wᵢ = aᵢ' (numerator ∂b red, denominator ∂w green, a terms black italic), distributed left, centre and right of the panel.
11. Panel 2 line 3: 'Conclusion:' in bold italic red, then 'b=f(W)=Σ_{i=1}^{n} aᵢwᵢ' (with summation limits n above / i=1 below), then 'then' in black, then '∂b/∂wᵢ = aᵢ' (∂b red, ∂w green). At the far right of the panel add 'One Term ONLY' in blue italic with 'ONLY' bold.
12. Draw panel 3: rectangle at x 7.5%-88%, y 66%-93%, fill #E8F5E9, outline #339933 ~1 pt.
13. Panel 3 line 1: 'c=f(a₁) , c=f(a₂) , c=f(a₃)    and    a₁=f(b) , a₂=f(b) , a₃=f(b)' in black italic serif, with 'and' in bold upright black.
14. Panel 3 line 2: 'c=f(b)  ⇒  if b is changed, c will be changed accordingly [ through a₁,a₂,a₃ ]' — 'c=f(b)' black italic, '⇒' red, 'b' and 'c' in the prose bold red, prose black upright, and the bracketed '[ through a₁,a₂,a₃ ]' in blue.
15. Panel 3 line 3: the long equation '∂c/∂b = [ ∂c/∂a₁ * ∂a₁/∂b ] + [ ∂c/∂a₂ * ∂a₂/∂b ] + [ ∂c/∂a₃ * ∂a₃/∂b ] = Σ_{i=1}^{3} ∂c/∂aᵢ * ∂aᵢ/∂b' with square brackets, ∂c red, ∂b green, ∂a blue, and a large summation with '3' above and 'i=1' below.
16. Add a solid black rectangle across the very bottom of the slide (x ~4%-95%, y ~96%-100%) to reproduce the video-player bar visible in the source image.
